import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with a single axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Use seaborn's barplot to visualize the distribution of megapixels by sensor type
sns.barplot(x='sensor_type', y='megapixels', data=cameras, ax=ax)

# Set axis labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Sensor Type')
ax.set_ylabel('Megapixels')
ax.set_title('Distribution of Megapixels by Sensor Type')

# Add a legend
ax.legend()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
